description: This source file implements the configuration management for wpaSupplicant, including loading, creating, modifying, and saving configurations. It manages configurations stored as key-value maps, supports parsing configuration files, and handles adding and deleting parameters.

methods.name: bool wld_wpaSupp_createConfig(wld_wpaSupp_config_t ** conf)
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new wld_wpaSupp_config_t structure, including global and network maps.

methods.name: bool wld_wpaSupp_loadConfig(wld_wpaSupp_config_t ** conf,char * path)
methods.description: Loads configuration data from a file into a wld_wpaSupp_config_t structure, parsing global and network parameters.

methods.name: bool wld_wpaSupp_deleteConfig(wld_wpaSupp_config_t * conf)
methods.description: Frees resources and deletes a loaded configuration structure.

methods.name: bool wld_wpaSupp_writeConfig(wld_wpaSupp_config_t * conf,char * path)
methods.description: Writes the configuration data from the structure into a specified file, with temporary file handling.

methods.name: bool wld_wpaSupp_addConfigParam(wld_wpaSupp_config_t * conf,const char * key,const char * value,bool isGlobal)
methods.description: Adds or updates a key-value pair in either the global or network configuration map.

methods.name: bool wld_wpaSupp_delConfigParam(wld_wpaSupp_config_t * conf,char * key)
methods.description: Deletes a key-value pair from the configuration, searching in both global and network maps.

methods.name: swl_mapChar_t * wld_wpaSupp_getGlobalConfig(wld_wpaSupp_config_t * conf)
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the global configuration map.

methods.name: swl_mapChar_t * wld_wpaSupp_getNetworkConfig(wld_wpaSupp_config_t * conf)
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the network configuration map.

ctags.signature: (wld_wpaSupp_config_t * conf,const char * key,const char * value,bool isGlobal)
